brief: Carry an unresolved obligation into the next plan without counting it twice.

title.es-MX: Lleva una cuenta pendiente una vez
title.pt-BR: Leve uma conta pendente uma vez

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Carry a bill forward once"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lleva una cuenta pendiente una vez"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leve uma conta pendente uma vez"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Carry an unresolved obligation into the next plan without counting it twice.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Keep an unpaid obligation visible without turning it into two different bills.
instruction.misconception: Erasing an unpaid bill at period-end or adding its old and carried-forward records as separate obligations.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: An unpaid bill remains owed next period. Carry its identifier and remaining amount forward, counting that obligation once.
Two records can refer to the same outstanding bill.
The repeated record does not create a second bill.
The same provider can issue distinct bills for different periods.
Verify actual updates instead of assuming or inventing charges.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
